title: Celebrate Love in Bali | Free Vintage Car Tour & Photoshoot
highlights: Experience the best of Bali with a perfect mix of temples, waterfalls, jungles, and romantic moments across Ubud, Kuta, and Nusa Penida.
Ride through Bali’s wild side on an ATV adventure, splashing through muddy trails and jungle paths for the ultimate off-road thrill.
Enjoy delicious meals at renowned restaurants in Bali with Thrillophilia's special food vouchers offering an exclusive 30% discount.
Ride through central Bali’s scenic landscapes on a vintage Volkswagen car tour, blending adventure, nostalgia, and stunning countryside views.
Enjoy a 5-star rooftop candlelight dinner at Mamaka by Ovolo, with ocean views and fine dining for the perfect romantic evening in the heart of Bali.
overview:
About the Tour:
Embark on a 6-day Bali escape filled with nature, culture, and romance. Begin in Ubud, where you can explore ancient Goa Gajah, colorful Bali Bird Park, or unwind at Waterbom Bali. Also, discover Tegenungan Waterfall, swing over lush valleys, and witness cleansing rituals at Tirta Empul before admiring the scenic Tegallalang Rice Terraces. Later, enjoy leisure time at Cretya Ubud’s infinity pools and explore Ubud’s artistic gems. Continue your adventure with a journey to Kuta. In Kuta, go for an adventurous ATV ride, then relax with a romantic candlelight dinner. Also, rejuvenate with a traditional Balinese massage, visit the clifftop Uluwatu Temple, and end the day with the captivating Kecak Fire Dance. Conclude your trip with cherished memories and tropical vibes.

know_before_you_go: Visa on Arrival (VOA) for Indonesia is not included in your package and must be obtained and paid for at the airport upon your arrival. Please ensure you have the necessary documents ready.
Complimentary activities included in your package are provided as a value addition, but if any of these are missed for any reason, they cannot be refunded, exchanged, or compensated.
Vehicles will follow a fixed point-to-point route as per the itinerary. Any changes or additional sightseeing requests may incur extra charges.
Bahasa Indonesia is the official language, and Balinese is also widely spoken. However, English is commonly understood in most tourist areas.
The local currency is the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR). While credit cards are accepted in many restaurants and hotels, cash is often preferred in smaller shops and markets.
When visiting temples or sacred sites, dress respectfully: cover your shoulders and knees, and wear a sarong and sash when required (often available at the entrance).

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Bali | Transfer to Ubud | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Bali! Upon arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport, board your transfer to your hotel in Ubud. Once there, check in to a beautifully decorated room & spend the rest of the day at leisure, where you can relax or set out to explore. You can discover Goa Gajah, the mystical ‘Elephant Cave’ adorned with sacred carvings, or visit Bali Bird Park to encounter exotic species in lush surroundings. Also, you can relax at Waterbom Bali, a world-class waterpark famed for its thrilling rides.

days.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour on a Vintage Volkswagen
days.desc: Begin your day with a complimentary floating breakfast, a unique experience. Then, enjoy a Central Bali Volkswagen vintage car tour, where classic charm meets countryside views. Next, feel the rush of unlimited rides on the iconic Bali Swing, soaring high over emerald valleys, before marveling at the scenic Tegenungan Waterfall. Also, visit Tirta Empul Temple, famed for its sacred spring pools, and visit the famous Sari Timbul. Later, explore the UNESCO-listed Tegallalang Rice Terrace.

items.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour with Tirta Empul Temple - Bali Swing + Tegenungan Waterfall + Tirta Empul + Sari Timbul + Tegallang Rice Terrace Tour on a Vintage Volkswagen

days.title: Bedugul Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, enjoy a scenic journey to the refreshing highlands of Bedugul. Begin at the iconic Handara Gate, known for its traditional Balinese design framed by mountains—perfect for a memorable photo stop. Continue to the serene Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, a majestic water temple floating on Lake Beratan, where spiritual charm meets breathtaking lakeside beauty. Conclude the day with a short trek to Leke Leke Waterfall, a hidden gem where clear waters cascade gracefully amidst lush tropical greenery.

items.title: Full Day Bedugul Tour in Bali - Handara Gate + Ulun Danu Beraton + Leke Leke Waterfalls

days.title: ATV Ride Experience | Visit to Cretya Ubud | Transfer to Kuta
days.desc: Post check-out, get driven for an adrenaline-pumping ATV ride, navigating Bali’s rugged trails, rice fields, and lush jungle paths for a thrilling adventure. After the ride, continue to Cretya Ubud, a stunning jungle club where infinity pools, vibrant tropical views, and lively ambience create the perfect spot to relax and unwind. Later, get transferred to Kuta, where golden beaches, bustling markets, and vibrant nightlife await. Once there, check in to your hotel and enjoy your overnight stay.

items.title: ATV Adventure in Bali - Tandem ATV Ride (Dual Rider)
Cretya Ubud, Bali - Visit to Cretya Ubud with Transfers

days.title: Watersports at Tenjung Benoa | Visit to Melasti Beach Tour | Uluwatu Temple Tour with Kecak Fire & Dance Show | Kuta Market Visit
days.desc: In the morning, get driven to visit Tanjung Benoa, Bali’s ultimate adventure hub, where exciting watersports like jet skiing, parasailing, and banana boat rides promise unforgettable experiences. After enjoying a delightful lunch, continue to Melasti Beach, renowned for its dramatic limestone cliffs. Later, visit the iconic Uluwatu Temple, perched majestically above the ocean, and witness the mesmerizing Kecak Fire Dance at sunset. Conclude the day browsing the vibrant stalls of Kuta Market.

items.title: Day Trip to Uluwatu Temple - Water Sports at Tanjung Benoa Beach + Uluwatu Temple Tour with Kecak Fire Dance Show + Melasti Beach + Kuta Market with Lunch

days.title: Full Day Nusa Penida West Tour with Paluang Cliff
days.desc: Today, get driven to Sanur Port and board a speedboat to Nusa Penida for a west coast adventure. Once there, get driven to the famous Kelingking Beach, known for its T-Rex–shaped cliff and ocean views. Continue to Angel’s Billabong, a natural infinity pool with sparkling clear waters, and admire the dramatic rock arch at Broken Bay. Next, head to Paluang Cliff for a unique vantage point of Kelingking, before ending the day at Crystal Bay, loved for its golden sands and laid-back charm.

days.title: Leisure Time in Kuta | Balinese Massage in Kuta | Candle Light Dinner at Mamaka by Ovolo
days.desc: Spend a leisurely morning in Kuta, where you can visit the lively Kuta Art Market, showcasing traditonal souvenirs and handicrafts. You can also stop at the Kuta Beach Sea Turtle Conservation Center to witness baby turtles. Later, relax with a traditional Balinese massage, known for its healing techniques and soothing touch. As evening falls, get driven to savor a romantic rooftop candlelight dinner at Mamaka by Ovolo, with ocean views and fine cuisine creating an unforgettable experience.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out from your hotel and proceed to the airport for your onward journey. As you board your flight, take with you the cherished memories of Bali—its serene temples, cascading waterfalls, thrilling adventures, and golden sunsets. This marks the end of your Bali tour, but the island’s charm and experiences will stay with you long after you’ve returned home.
